tools.description: File name, version, last modified time, and node count — reads the local mirror (no Figma API cost).

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

tools.name: figmog_status

tools.description: List the file's pages (CANVAS nodes), in document order — reads the local mirror (no Figma API cost).

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

tools.name: figmog_pages

tools.description: Subtree outline (id, name, type, children) rooted at a node, defaulting to the whole document — reads the local mirror (no Figma API cost).

depth.description: Max depth to descend; omitted means unlimited.

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

id.description: Root node id; defaults to the DOCUMENT node.

tools.name: figmog_tree

tools.description: Full raw JSON of one node by id, optionally with a one-level children summary and/or a resolved_variables annotation — reads the local mirror (no Figma API cost).

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

resolve_vars.description: Annotate boundVariables binding sites with variable names/values under a resolved_variables key.

tools.name: figmog_node

tools.description: Full raw JSON of a node and its descendants, nested under `children` in child-index order — reads the local mirror (no Figma API cost). Use `depth` and `fields` to keep the response small; an unbounded dump of a large subtree can be huge.

depth.description: Max depth to descend; omitted means unlimited.

fields.description: Project every node to these raw fields (id/name/type/children always survive). Recommended for large subtrees.

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

resolve_vars.description: Annotate boundVariables binding sites with variable names/values under a resolved_variables key.

tools.name: figmog_subtree

tools.description: Nodes by Figma node type, optionally scoped to one page and/or a subtree — reads the local mirror (no Figma API cost).

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

page.description: Page (CANVAS) node id to scope to.

under.description: Scope to the subtree rooted at this node id (inclusive).

tools.name: figmog_find

tools.description: BM25 search over layer names and text content, optionally scoped to a subtree — reads the local mirror (no Figma API cost).

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

under.description: Scope to the subtree rooted at this node id (inclusive).

tools.name: figmog_search

tools.description: Instances of a component, resolved by node id, global key, or component/component-set name — reads the local mirror (no Figma API cost).

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

target.description: Node id, key, or name of a component or component set.

tools.name: figmog_instances

tools.description: Design-system inventory: component sets with their variant axes, plus standalone components — reads the local mirror (no Figma API cost).

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

tools.name: figmog_components

tools.description: Styles with usage counts; `values` derives each style's definition from a consumer node — reads the local mirror (no Figma API cost).

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

resolve_vars.description: With values, annotate the definition's variable bindings under a resolved_variables key.

type.description: Style type filter, e.g. FILL, TEXT.

values.description: Derive each style's definition from a consumer node.

tools.name: figmog_styles

tools.description: Nodes using a style id or bound to a variable id — reads the local mirror (no Figma API cost).

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

id.description: A style id or variable id.

tools.name: figmog_uses

tools.description: Variables: the authoritative record if imported via figmog import-variables, else inferred from bindings — reads the local mirror (no Figma API cost).

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

id.description: Variable id filter; omitted means all variables.

tools.name: figmog_vars

tools.description: Forces one pull from Figma and returns the sync churn (+added ~changed -removed) — fetches from Figma (spends Tier-1 rate budget).

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

tools.name: figmog_sync

tools.description: Node counts by type and by page, component/set/style/variable totals, text-node count, max tree depth — reads the local mirror (no Figma API cost).

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

tools.name: figmog_stats

tools.description: Ancestor chain from the document root to a node, as [{id, name, type}] — reads the local mirror (no Figma API cost).

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

tools.name: figmog_path

tools.description: Every TEXT node's (id, characters, page_id), optionally scoped to one page and/or a subtree, sorted by id — reads the local mirror (no Figma API cost).

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

under.description: Scope to the subtree rooted at this node id (inclusive).

tools.name: figmog_text

tools.description: Nodes whose raw JSON matches an RFC 6901 pointer, optionally filtered by value and/or scoped to a page/subtree — reads the local mirror (no Figma API cost).

equals.description: JSON value to match; omitted means "pointer exists".

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 pointer into the node's raw JSON, e.g. /layoutMode.

under.description: Scope to the subtree rooted at this node id (inclusive).

tools.name: figmog_where

tools.description: Download node renders and/or fill images (v0.0.2 spec §5), cached by file version — spends Figma API budget (the images endpoints are the most rate-limited; never called automatically). Returns a JSON manifest plus, per item up to 1MB encoded: an image content block (base64) for raster formats, or the raw SVG markup as a text block for format=svg; larger items point at the CLI's `figmog images --out` instead.

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

format.description: Render format: png or svg (default png).

ids.description: Node ids (or Figma URLs carrying node-id=) to render, and/or to scan for fill imageRefs.

tools.name: figmog_images

tools.description: Nodes whose absolute bounds contain a point, sorted by area ascending (deepest/smallest first) — reads the local mirror (no Figma API cost).

file.description: Figma file URL or key; omit for the default mirrored file.

tools.name: figmog_at

tools.description: Mirror a Figma file now (spends one Tier-1 pull) — creates the mirror if it's new, or re-syncs it if already mirrored. Returns the sync churn and node count.

file.description: Figma file URL or key to mirror.

geometry.description: Request vector path data (fillGeometry/strokeGeometry) on this pull. Sticky (spec §4): once set, every later pull of this mirror keeps requesting it until a `pull --fresh`. Omitted preserves whatever this mirror already has stored; default false for a brand-new mirror.

tools.name: figmog_open

tools.description: List every mirrored file: key, name, version, node count, last synced time, and which one is the default — reads local state only (no Figma API cost).
tools.name: figmog_files
